products.fixture_contract: Actual headless production app reducers, real SettingsSave/final-save worker and temporary Settings/SQLite stores. The three original equal-read scenarios and all original assertion predicates remain unchanged. This source adds only scenario and saved/result Err diagnostics before the original success assertion and before ACK application; it is not a causal repair. No native window, provider, terminal or executable helper is launched by the controller.

original_negative.scope: Original final shared-read parent actually failed before ACK; saved/result error and scenario were omitted. First four UI parents passed at the predecessor only. No old pass qualifies40a; the new invocation obtains actual diagnostics and must not be reclassified as a repair.

limits: Temporary isolated research control only; never merge. Preparation is not queue admission, publication or dispatch authorization. Parent must grant a shared lane before execution.

One serial hosted job, CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2, one browserless UI target and one isolated UI binary check followed by one exact compiled inventory and one exact parent invocation. Exactly three planned phases; planned counts are not executed results. No CLI/HOST builds, graph unification, helper build, provider or native launcher.
Natural hosted User context is mandatory: refuse every inherited CAGENTS_ name by presence without reading values or clearing authority. Source Cargo checkout-root configuration stays intact.

Pin exact source head/tree/clean status, source hashes, build configuration/input hashes, control head/tree/workflow and proven setup action. Recheck source/config/context around every command; retain original stdout/stderr/command/exits/digests and final source state.

Each command retains GNU timeout2700s plus30s TERM-to-KILL grace and direct-wrapper wait accounting. Uncertain timeout/signal/wrapper, context, source or config faults stop globally; ordinary settled check/inventory/parent failure stops dependent phases and fails qualification. No retry, ignored-test waiver or evidence replacement.

One exact inventory entry and one matching named outer parent plus a single1P0F0I summary are required for success. A real runtime failure remains a failure while its raw diagnostic payload is retained; inner lines are never salvaged.

All three scenarios, original production Arc/no-op/title guards, real final-save/settings-writer ownership and original ten assertion predicates are preserved in the pinned source. Obtain actual saved/result Err before proposing a causal correction; no speculative repair is included.
The previous final-save negative and earlier cancelled-close negative remain at original source/run scopes. No prior pass transfers to this source.

No native close/recovery interaction, matched screenshots, UX acceptance, responsiveness, whole feature suite, integrated-browser, commercial provider or merge readiness is established. All current Cargo/test/helper/native/provider/workflow execution is UNRUN.
